product_metadata.title: Ottomanson Studio Collection Chevron Waves Design Area Rug, 3'3" X 5'0", Grey
features: Functional features such as stain-resistance, non-slip rubber back, non-shedding and fade resistant low profile surface pile are brilliantly combined with chic fashionable or traditional designs and elegant colors. | Machine-made in Turkey with high quality nylon which is serviceable and naturally stain-resistant to give this rug comfort and functionality under your feet for long hours even in spaces where your house gets lots of traffic.

Perfectly convenient for your busy home or office with kids, pets, visitors and heavy traffic areas like in the kitchen, by the kitchen sink or stove area, living room, dining room, teens room, guest room, nursery room, TV room, kids room, entrance, dorm room, bedroom, family room, staircase, foyer, entryways and hallways Skidless rubber backing promotes safe stepping for you and your pets; and allows for this chic rug to stay in place with optimal slip resistance.

Exquisitely textured soft pile gently caresses your bare feet and creates a comfy stepping. Sturdily bound on all edges to provide longevity and prevent fraying or curling. You can have peace of mind - You are guaranteed to get a great quality durable and long lasting rug for competetive budget-friendly pricing. Ottomanson earned customers' spurs and has been a trusted brand for unsurpassed quality and style in the area rug category.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Super easy to clean, this rug is made of premium nylon material which is naturally stain-resistant. For stains or spills, immediately and gently remove excess liquid with a clean, dry cloth or paper towel. Follow by blotting with a damp washing cloth and a mild detergent. Always blot the stain, rubbing will work it into the fibers and make it harder to remove. Vacuum regularly to prolong the life of your rug! [We DO NOT recommend machine washing our rubber back rugs because the pressure and heat may damage the rubber backing.]
description: Revamp your dull spaces into areas of visual intrigue with our stylish Studio collection featuring colorful contemporary designs and the practicality of a stain-resistant, non-shedding soft pile completed with non-slip rubber backing. The Studio Collection promotes rugs and runner rugs that are both functional and decorative to contribute a trendy compliment to your space and home decor whilst preserving your floors from dirt, scratches, wear and tear. Boost up your spirit instantly and effortlessly when you roll out this versatile rug featuring an energetic chevron waves design with uneven lines forming a zigzag motif in the neutral hues of black and ivory composing a modern and fashionable flair. As an eye-catching piece, this high-quality yet budget-friendly rug will also create a focal point with simple yet classy striped design in a charming chevron pattern for a unique look that will sophisticate the surrounding decor and furniture in your home or office. Resistant to fading, stains and shedding, this durable rug offers a fuss-free maintanence and can be an ideal choice for homes with kids and pets as well as heavy traffic areas like hallways, kitchens, entryways, living rooms. Machine-woven loop texture with 100% nylon pile makes this rug easy to lay flat and feels comfortable under your, your kids' and pets' feet; while the non-slip rubber backing helps with grip so your rug stays safely in place without moving even when you vacuum. Dense construction ensures durable and long-lasting service; and the utilitarian low-profile pile, made of premium quality nylon, provides stain and fade resistance as well as shed-free performance, which all make this rug suitable for even the most high-traffic areas at your house with breeze-like maintenance. Convert your house into a home with a finishing touch by simply setting one rug from this collection under your kitchen table, in your living room, hallways or by your foyer to greet your guests in a gracefully welcoming manner.
